title: App Root Component Orchestration
description: Manages top-level state, engine lifecycle, and data synchronization.
body: The App component orchestrates the entire Schematify interface. It manages tier navigation state (path array of DrillTargets), opens and closes Schematics via the engine, fetches linting findings and runs project-wide (once per mount, not per tier switch), handles Problems panel click-through navigation, loads product graph data lazily on first access to Product/Decisions sections, and manages the module dashboard overlay. Wave 7b and Wave 10c changes are integrated: findings click-through can navigate to a different Schematic, and Product/Decisions panels swap the center body entirely.
